title: Shinsetsu Yumemi Yakata: Tobira no Oku ni Dareka ga...
native_title: 真説・夢見館 扉の奥に誰かが…
overview:
Tonight... lit by a red full moon as if stained with blood, the "Yumemi Mansion" awakens once more.

The holy messenger who radiates light appears together with calamity. The full moon summons calamity, and those who are bewitched become butterflies.

On a night of a blood-red moon, Jun is summoned to the Yumemi Mansion by its Elder, who fears the moon is a bad omen. Jun can see the souls of the residents, who have left the outside world to live in the mansion as butterflies, and must unravel their messages to uncover the danger that threatens to destroy it.

This first-person adventure lets you move through the mansion's rooms and halls, examine objects and collect items. Guided by Mike, one of the mansion's souls, you talk with the ghostly residents, answer them yes or no, and learn their pasts to solve their problems and reveal the mystery.

- 1 player
- Normal and Easy modes
- Memory backup support

今宵…血で染まった如き赤い満月に照らされて「夢見館」は再び目覚める。

光を放つ聖なる使者は災いと共に現れる。満月は災いを呼び魅入られし者は蝶となる。
